messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty: LATENCY_ALERT fired for service=reinfer-api env=prod region=us-west p99=7.8s threshold=5s. Autopager triggered and page sent to rotation.
eng_oncall_matt: Acked pager. Looking at grafana now — p95 also creeping. link: https://grafana.redwood/s/latency?var-service=reinfer-api
sre_anya: Any customer-facing errors? ticket noise?
prodops_jules: Checking logs, not seeing 5xx spikes. Mostly long-tail generation requests and embeddings peaking. Few hotkeys in kv-cache show elevated hit/miss.
eng_oncall_matt: Repro dashboard shows spike aligned with a big batch from partner-x heavy embeddings job around 09:12PT. Might be batch overload + sidecar backpressure.
sre_lead_tom: Can we short-circuit partner traffic to dedicated pool or lower concurrency? If we can't, consider temporary suppression of autopager duplicates while we remediate.
eng_oncall_matt: I can flip routing rule to route partner-x to low-priority pool. Doing a quick run:
```
# move partner-x to overflow pool
redwood route update --service reinfer-api --match "client=partner-x" --target overflow-pool --dry-run
redwood route update --service reinfer-api --match "client=partner-x" --target overflow-pool
```
prodops_jules: 👍 watching KV metrics — hotkey set is reducing, but we might still have backlog in tokenizers.
incident-bot: Note: autopager suppression window suggestion: suppress duplicate pages for 10m (would have suppressed 3 additional pages).
sre_anya: Don't auto-suppress yet. We need at least one clear successful mitigation and p99 back to normal before muting. Customers might be affected.
eng_oncall_matt: Route change applied. Also pausing request batching for partner-x sidecars for 5min to reduce tail. Command run: `kubectl -n infer patch deploy sidecar-partner-x -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"sidecar","env":[{"name":"BATCHING_ENABLED","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'`
prodops_jules: Patch is rolling. Metrics show queue length on tokenizer nodes dropping after ~40s.
sre_lead_tom: PagerDuty: escalation if not resolved in 15m — heads up to infra-sre.
eng_oncall_matt: Quick smoke: p99 down to 4.9s, p95 1.2s. Still above target but trending down.
sre_anya: Any partial customer impact? CS Slack shows one partner reported intermittent slow responses but no widespread outages.
prodops_jules: Confirmed 2k affected requests in 09:10–09:18 window, mostly long-run generations. We'll correlate billing/SLAs after.
eng_oncall_matt: Will leave sidecar batching off for 10 more mins and monitor. If stable, revert routing after warmup.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: eng_oncall_matt acknowledged; no escalation triggered yet.
sre_lead_tom: Good mitigation. After stabilization, open a short postmortem: root cause hypothesis = single high-concurrency partner workload + batching + hotkeys thrash. Suggest rate-limiting or dedicated pool for heavy partners.
sre_anya: Agreed. Also file follow-up to tune autopager dedup heuristics so we don't blind-alert on noisy bursts while ensuring escalation on sustained SLO burn.
eng_oncall_matt: p99 now 3.2s, p95 0.9s. I'll close this thread after 10 more minutes of stable metrics.
prodops_jules: Noted customer impacts, no action required for billing yet but flag for account team.
eng_oncall_matt: Closing in 10. :white_check_mark: Thanks all.
